retrieval_method: PubMed primary publication abstracts viewed through web tool
rights: ADA copyright notices observed; no full-text redistribution licence established. Independently encoded published aggregate facts only; no article, table, supplement or participant records copied.

studies.relationship: Rechecked existing sensitivity-only evidence, not a new cohort acquisition
studies.population: Patients younger than 20 with diabetes attending six clinics in South West England and Tayside; 79.5% of eligible population participated
studies.calendar_period: not verified in this abstract screen
studies.endpoint: Study-defined monogenic diabetes after biomarker triage and testing for 29 causes
studies.transformation: 100 * numerator / denominator, rounded to one decimal; no new interval estimation
studies.limitations: Selected clinic participants; triage-dependent ascertainment; age, molecular scope and calendar compatibility unresolved for a new target

studies.population: Diabetes diagnosed at age 30 or younger, current age below 50, two UK regions with high existing detection
studies.calendar_period: not verified in this abstract screen
studies.endpoint: Study-defined monogenic diabetes, existing cases plus newly detected cases following biomarker triage and testing for 35 subtypes
studies.transformation: 100 * numerator / denominator, rounded to one decimal; no new interval estimation
studies.limitations: Not all-age or general-population prevalence; high prior ascertainment; study-defined denominator includes cystic-fibrosis-related diabetes

overlap_assessment: Potential shared recruitment geography and research programme; participant independence not established. Do not pool or split these reports into training and validation sets.
comparison_disposition: Neither study directly validates fictional D/E/G populations, outcome rates or currency. Arithmetic agreement with published rounding is extraction QA, not empirical model validation.
